messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: oncall-eng-sre — high error rate observed for model-service v3b in prod region us-west-2. Please acknowledge.
sasha_oncall: Acked. jumping in. what's the symptom?
mike_infra: Metrics: 5xx spike on text-generation endpoint at 17:14 UTC, tokenization errors in logs. Canary nodes show garbled tokens.
priya_sre: Sounds like a tokenizer mismatch or weightset tag mismatch. Rollout started 17:10 with weightset 'weights-v3b-2026-03-17'.
chris_prod: Confirming customers: several mid-market tenants saw gibberish completions and increased latency. Support ticket 12345 opened by Acme Corp.
nora_support: Acme says model responses are unreadable and causing business logic failures. They throttled calls.
sasha_oncall: Can someone grep runtime logs for "invalid-bpe" and "kv-error"?
mike_infra: Pasting recent logs:
```
2026-03-17T17:13:42Z model-runtime[pod-23] ERROR tokenizer: mismatched-vocab incoming=tokenizer-v2 expected=tokenizer-v3b
2026-03-17T17:13:42Z model-runtime[pod-23] WARN weights: signature-mismatch weight-tag=weights-v3b-2026-03-17 expected-sha=abc123 got=def456
```
priya_sre: That's the smoking gun — weightset promoted with a different tokenizer artifact. Canary policy should've caught it but the label aliasing passed.
sasha_oncall: Impact: customer-facing inference returns garbled text -> severity P1 for multiple tenants. We'll initiate live mitigation.
chris_prod: Recommend immediate rollback to weights-v3b-2026-03-10 (last-good).
mike_infra: Preparing rollback steps. Suggest flipping feature flag `deploy.v3b.active` -> false to divert traffic, then revert alias mapping.
sasha_oncall: Priya, can you flip the livekill feature flag? I don't want a full cluster restart.
priya_sre: Doing a controlled kill: `/featureflag toggle deploy.v3b.active off --reason "tokenizer-weight mismatch"`
incident-bot: Feature flag `deploy.v3b.active` toggled OFF by priya_sre at 17:18 UTC.
chris_prod: Traffic is shifting to previous variant. Latency dropping, error rate decreasing. Watching.
mike_infra: Starting automated weight alias revert: `alias promote weights-v3b-2026-03-10 to current` (dry-run ok).
priya_sre: Alias revert submitted. Oncall, please verify KV cache flush on serving nodes for tokenizer artifacts.
sasha_oncall: Flushing KV cache via `runtime-tools flush-tokenizer-cache --scope=us-west-2`.
mike_infra: KV caches flushed. Canary pods now reporting tokenizer v3b-old. Error logs cleared.
nora_support: Acme confirms responses are back to normal. They've un-throttled calls.
chris_prod: Post-mitigation: 5xx down to baseline, latency normalized. Will hold rollout and block autopromote pipelines.
sasha_oncall: Root cause hypothesis: CI artifact push included weights built against an unreleased tokenizer binary with different vocab namespace. Labels matched due to tag aliasing glitch in promo job.
priya_sre: Actions: 1) Hold rollout, 2) Re-run artifact verification to ensure tokenizer/weight SHA pairs, 3) Add token-vocab SHA check in canary gating, 4) Notify customers.
mike_infra: I'll open infra task to add a canary-enforcer job that rejects weightset promotions without matching tokenizer digest.
sasha_oncall: Assign owners: mike_infra -> infra fix, priya_sre -> gating rule and feature flag runbook update, chris_prod -> customer comms.
chris_prod: I'll send an incident summary and a brief to affected customers.
nora_support: Notifying Acme and others now.
sasha_oncall: Closing pager: mitigation successful. We'll keep this thread for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
